description: California LIHEAP helps eligible households with heating or cooling costs through local energy agencies. Available funding and local priorities affect assistance.
introduction: California LIHEAP helps eligible households with heating or cooling costs through local energy agencies. Available funding and local priorities affect assistance.

sections.who: The agency checks household income, size, energy costs and other eligibility conditions. The 2026 state income table is a screening reference; the local agency determines eligibility.
sections.get: Bill assistance and energy-crisis services can help meet immediate energy needs. Ask the provider which component is available for a regular bill, shutoff or fuel emergency.
sections.docs: Prepare all household income, residence and current energy bills. The state plan requires evidence of energy-cost responsibility and relevant eligibility factors.
sections.apply:
1. Use the local-provider links on CSD’s LIHEAP page and contact the agency serving your address.

  2. Ask about current intake, required records and crisis handling. State any shutoff date or loss of heating/cooling before arranging the application.
sections.after: Keep the award notice and verify the account credit. Discuss payment arrangements with the utility while waiting. Read the decision’s appeal instructions if you disagree.
sections.sources:
Application and program details: LIHEAP and local providers, 2026 income table, Program eligibility and crisis components.

Historical screenshots and background: USA Assistance. Screenshots may show an earlier application interface.

faqs: Is there one statewide application office?
Does falling below the table guarantee assistance?
No. The provider checks other requirements, priorities and funding.
What if my utility is about to disconnect?
Tell the provider the date and ask about crisis services; also contact the utility.
Is LIHEAP the same as CARE?
No. CARE is a recurring bill discount; LIHEAP provides eligible energy assistance.
